result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.colorize_node_attrs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Map node attribute values to colors. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8312-L8452){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.colorize_node_attrs( node_attr_from=None, values=None, node_attr_to="color", palette="default", alpha=None, nodes=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Sets a color attribute on nodes based on categorical or continuous values. For categorical data, assigns distinct colors from a palette. For continuous data, interpolates between colors. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_attr_from]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Attribute name to read values from (e.g., 'community', 'type'). If `None`, must provide values dict. [values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, Any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to values. If `None`, reads from `node_attr_from=` attribute. [node_attr_to]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["color"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Attribute name to write colors to (e.g., 'color', 'fillcolor', etc.). [palette]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["default"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Color palette name or list of hex color strings. Available palettes: ColorBrewer (e.g., 'Greens', 'RdBu', 'Set1'), Viridis ('viridis', 'magma', 'plasma'), or 'default'. [alpha]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Alpha transparency (0-100), not yet implemented. [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[list[str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Subset of nodes to colorize (default: all nodes). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Color by community: ::: {#e76cd001 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec G = ec.Graph(directed=False) for i in range(6): G.add_node(label=str(i)) # Create two communities G.add_edge(source="0", target="1") G.add_edge(source="1", target="2") G.add_edge(source="0", target="2") G.add_edge(source="3", target="4") G.add_edge(source="4", target="5") G.add_edge(source="3", target="5") # Detect communities and colorize G.cmty_louvain(attr_name="community") G.colorize_node_attrs(node_attr_from="community", palette="vibrant") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 6 Number of edges : 6 Directed : False Density : 0.40 Average degree (min, max) : 2.00 (2, 2) Connected : False Number of connected components : 2 Tree : False Bipartite : False Computations on nodes: - cmty_louvain() -> attr: 'community' (6 of 6 nodes) Node aesthetics: - color <- community via colorize (palette: "vibrant") (values: #377eb8, #e41a1c, 6 of 6 nodes) ``` ::: ::: Color by node type: ::: {#2593b9cc .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Create graph with typed nodes G = ec.Graph() G.add_node(label="A", type="person") G.add_node(label="B", type="person") G.add_node(label="C", type="organization") G.add_edge(source="A", target="B") G.add_edge(source="B", target="C") G.colorize_node_attrs(node_attr_from="type", palette="tableau") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : False Density : 0.67 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True Node aesthetics: - color <- type via colorize (palette: "tableau") (values: #4e79a7, #f28e2c, 3 of 3 nodes) ``` ::: ::: Custom color list: ::: {#cfbde973 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} G = ec.Graph() G.add_node(label="A", status="active") G.add_node(label="B", status="inactive") G.add_edge(source="A", target="B") G.colorize_node_attrs( node_attr_from="status", palette=["#ff0000", "#00ff00"] ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True Node aesthetics: - color <- status via colorize (palette: "custom") (values: #00ff00, #ff0000, 2 of 2 nodes) ``` ::: :::
